# Weft 1.1.22
- Launch desktop applications directly from a service’s preview action, using the selected worktree’s checkout and ready service URLs. - Keep desktop app data separate for each worktree, with configurable application identities for native shells. - Keep a desktop preview visible in the right-hand inspector, with a sleeping badge when the app is closed. - View desktop launch status and logs, stop the entire process tree, and launch a build independently of development servers. - Control desktop launches through the CLI and MCP using the same reviewed configuration as the app. - Discover supported desktop launch settings during new-project setup and carry the reviewed settings into new worktrees automatically.
